evidence: Homepage listing.grid shows 8 cards; listing.results shows '共 8 个非遗项目' matching the 8 displayed items.
All 8 items use only categories: 民俗活动(Folk Activities), 传统美术(Traditional Art), 传统表演(Performing Arts), 传统工艺(Traditional Crafts).
Each card (e.g. 春节) shows title, English subtitle, category badge (民俗活动), region (北京 · 华夏大地), brief description paragraph, and 了解详情 link.
Detail page for 苏绣 shows title, English subtitle, category (传统工艺), region (江苏 · 江南水乡), inclusion year (2006年入选), full description paragraph, and a gallery with 3 selectable thumbnail images.

Clicking thumbnail 1 shows image 苏绣-1 in main area; clicking thumbnail 2 (a broken source) shows explicit '图片加载失败' failure message in the main area instead of a broken image; clicking thumbnail 3 updates main image to 苏绣-3.

Images used for 苏绣 (Suzhou Embroidery) are embroidery/textile-craft style stock photos (unsplash) consistent with the item description; thumbnails 1 and 3 render distinct relevant images, thumbnail 2 shows explicit failure rather than an unrelated image.
Clicking '浏览更多项目' on the suzhou-embroidery detail page navigated to http://localhost:6063/#categories, which renders the homepage project list (listing.grid with all 8 items).

Before navigating to detail page, sort was set to 按地区 (region) with category=all and search empty. After returning to homepage from the suzhou-embroidery detail page, listing.sort still shows 按地区 selected and listing.grid remains sorted by region (安徽, 北京, 北京, 广东, 江苏x3, 陕西), with all 8 items still shown.

Search '京剧' narrowed grid to 1 matching item with count '共 1 个非遗项目'; category filter 'craft' (传统工艺) narrowed to 2 items (苏绣, 宜兴紫砂) with count '共 2 个非遗项目'; sort 'region' reordered all 8 items alphabetically by province (安徽, 北京, 北京, 广东, 江苏x3, 陕西).

Visiting /heritage/nonexistent-item-xyz shows heading '未找到该非遗项目' (item not found) and a '返回首页' link back to homepage, with no unrelated project details rendered. Valid link /heritage/suzhou-embroidery earlier opened the correct matching item.

Clicking the 苏绣 hotspot in the panorama opened an overlay with title 苏绣, category 传统工艺, region 江苏 · 江南水乡, brief description, 3 images, and a '查看详情' link to /heritage/suzhou-embroidery plus a '继续探索' close action.

Dragging the panorama shifted translateX and background gradient angle, causing different hotspots to appear/disappear (suzhou-embroidery, kunqu-opera hidden; dragon-boat, spring-festival appeared) as the view rotated; dragging back to the original position restored suzhou-embroidery and other original hotspots. Zooming in (scale 1.2) and out (scale 0.8) preserved all 4 currently-in-view hotspots as clickable action items; none were permanently lost.

Before navigating to the suzhou-embroidery detail page, panorama transform was scale(0.8) translateX(-18px) with gradient angle 138.6deg. After using browser back navigation from the detail page, the panorama transform was restored to the identical scale(0.8) translateX(-18px) / 138.6deg state.
